title: Smooth pullback exchange for exceptional inverse image
statement:
Work in the finite-coefficient purity conventions [def-pur-conventions], with $\Lambda=A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ and $n\geq1$. Let $X,X',Y,Y'$ be finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X'&\xrightarrow{\ u\ }&X\\
f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
Y'&\xrightarrow{\ v\ }&Y
\end{array}
$$
be a Cartesian square of $k$-morphisms [def-pc-base-change], with $f$ separated and of finite type, smooth of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$, the bounded constructible finite-Tor category of [def-pur-conventions]. The morphism $v$ is arbitrary in this finite-type setting; no smoothness, flatness or properness of $v$ is assumed. All the following objects and maps are on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with the derived pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and constructible exceptional inverse images [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image].

Use the smooth purity maps $\gamma$ of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], formed from the canonical diagonal identifications of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object] and the canonical tensor isomorphisms of [thm-pur-cohomological-smoothness]. Their inverses are thus specified inverses of these maps. Here $f'$ has the same smooth relative dimension by [lem-sbc-smooth-relative-dimension-permanence] and is separated finite type by [lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change]. For the finite-Tor constructible domain of $Lv^*K$, use the bounded-constructible pullback and site comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-pullback-preserves-bounded-constructible, lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin], and the bounded flat models and preservation of flat modules of [lem-sf-flat-model, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-flat-module-pullback].

Write $c_{h,g}:L(g\circ h)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*Lg^*$ for the canonical composition isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. For $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, write
$$
 a_{u,M}:Lu^*(M(d)[2d])\xrightarrow{\sim}(Lu^*M)(d)[2d]
$$
for the canonical tensor comparison of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso] followed by the pullback identification $Lu^*A_X(d)\cong A_{X'}(d)$ of [det-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients-twists], with the twist convention [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. The shift comparison is the termwise identification for exact finite-coefficient pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the cochain shift of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define the middle identification to be
$$
 b_{\square,K}:Lu^*((Lf^*K)(d)[2d])
 \xrightarrow{a_{u,Lf^*K}}(Lu^*Lf^*K)(d)[2d]
 \xrightarrow{c_{u,f,K}^{-1}(d)[2d]}(L(f\circ u)^*K)(d)[2d]
 \xrightarrow{c_{f',v,K}(d)[2d]}(Lf'^*Lv^*K)(d)[2d],
$$
where the last arrow uses the equality $f\circ u=v\circ f'$ of the square.

The *smooth pullback exchange* is the isomorphism defined by the typed composite
$$
\operatorname{Ex}^{!,\mathrm{sm}}_{f,v,K}:
Lu^*Rf^!K
\xrightarrow{\ (Lu^*\gamma_{f,K})^{-1}\ }
Lu^*((Lf^*K)(d)[2d])
\xrightarrow{\ b_{\square,K}\ }
(Lf'^*Lv^*K)(d)[2d]
\xrightarrow{\ \gamma_{f',Lv^*K}\ }
Rf'^!Lv^*K.
$$
This notation specifies the purity composite, rather than denoting a right-adjoint mate of compact-support base change.

proof.text: Use the existing root-chart construction and exact-derived shift comparisons to form the stated pullback compositor and square map. For the chart-independent source map, apply lem-pur-finite-source-chart-scalar-transition to two primitive roots, obtaining the same natural-number scalar r for every source chart. The additive pullback preserves it. Conjugating by its shift comparison gives r times the identity on the shifted double pullback. For s,s′ and t,t′ the two source and target charts, the equations s^{-1}s′=r id and t^{-1}t′=r id imply s m t^{-1}=s′ m (t′)^{-1}: postcompose with t′ and use bilinearity to commute the repeated-addition scalar past m. This is the proved private scalar_chart_composite. The composition comparisons are the constructions of def-pur-composition-comparisons; the composition-coherence proposition is not applied. Its existing normalized pullback compositor is recorded under thm-pur-composition-coherence, so that owning node remains a dependency.

The annihilating exponent is invertible in the base field by def-coefficient-twists-detailed. Mathlib HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.exists_primitiveRoot supplies one primitive root. The common composite in this chart gives existence. Every map satisfying all chart equations equals that value, giving uniqueness. This constructs exactly finiteReductionBaseChangeSource, independently of purity.

For finiteReductionBaseChangeInput, retain the actual intrinsic K. Descend it to a bounded constructible ordinary-etale representative J using lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin. Exact ordinary-etale inverse image preserves bounded constructibility; the finite-value/source-library constructibility equivalence is lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison. The canonical comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso, its exact-derived compositor, and the realization unit identify the intrinsic comparison of v*J with the specified finiteReductionPullback v K. Apply lem-exc-comparison-tor-interval to transfer the existing ordered Tor interval from K to J. The already proved source-library torAmplitudeIn_leftDerivedUpperStar applies to arbitrary v: it takes the bounded flat model of lem-sf-etale-flat-model termwise under exact inverse image. Inverse image preserves flat module sheaves by the geometric-fiber criterion lem-sfb-etale-flat-geometric-fibers. It therefore preserves this same interval on v*J. Transfer it back and transport along the explicit comparison isomorphism. The essential-image theorem also gives bounded support and intrinsic constructibility of the result. No property of v beyond its stated type is used.

For finiteReductionPurityIsIso obtain an ordinary-etale representative J of K by lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin. It is bounded below. The finite compared coefficient exponent is invertible on X by def-pur-co-smoothness. Apply the orientation-free canonical tensor formula lem-sf-smooth-dualizing-complex-invertible to make the actual ordinary-etale tensor mate invertible at J. The comparison adjunction unit is invertible on bounded-below objects by thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison. The displayed factors of smoothPurityTheta are therefore invertible, as is smoothPurityTensorMapInPresentation after tensoring with the inverse of the specified diagonal orientation. The defining uniqueness theorem of def-pur-smooth-purity-map identifies its chosen tensor map with this concrete presentation. Finally coefficient realization and the reassociation isomorphism preserve invertibility. This uses only relative separatedness of f, never absolute separatedness of X or Y.

The existing definition finiteReductionSmoothExchange is the inverse of the pullback of the first purity isomorphism, followed by finiteReductionBaseChangeSource and the base-changed purity isomorphism. Supply the two proved invertibility instances and the proved finite-Tor input. This is literally the specified composite and leaves all existing definitions and signatures unchanged.
